title: Fan Base and Isolation Selector
description: Scenario recommender: for seven illustrative fan installations the learner chooses one of five base or mounting recommendations and one of three justifications; both must match, with two attempts per scenario and a summary of every first answer against the correct one.
creator: Twin City Fan
subject: unitary base
isolation base
inertia base
isolator mounting methods
internally isolated fan
vibration isolation
rights: Copyright 2026 Twin City Fan. All rights reserved.

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
educational.topic: Choosing a fan base or isolator mounting
learningObjectives: The learner will recommend a base or mounting for a described fan installation and justify it with the FanPedia rule that governs the case.

accessibility.notes: describe() text (fallback mode); verdicts announced through FP.announce (aria-live); ✓/✗ glyphs, written status labels and solid/dashed borders pair with colour; keys 1-5 and A-C choose, Submit takes focus once both are chosen, Enter submits and moves on; reason buttons carry the full justification in aria-label; text never below 12 px; the summary splits into two pages on narrow screens.

controls.label: Next scenario / See summary
controls.purpose: Move on; in the summary on narrow screens, switch pages

controls.label: Start over
controls.purpose: Reset all seven scenarios and the score

rules: Exact match on both recommendation and justification.
Scenario order and the two distractor justifications per scenario are fixed by seed 22.
Two attempts per scenario; after the second wrong attempt the answer and justification are shown and the scenario counts as missed.
Mastery is 6 of 7 on the first attempt.
limitations: Does not size isolators or select deflections (see the Isolator Transmissibility Explorer and Chapter 23).

sources: FanPedia: The Fan & Blower Encyclopedia (Twin City Fan), pp. 131-133, 143, 165, 166, https://tcf.com/fanpedia/. Scenarios are illustrative.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit a recommendation and its justifying rule together; the justification step separates a correct guess from a correct judgment
keyQuestions: What should this fan sit on?
Does this installation need isolation at all?
What does the arrangement allow underneath the fan?
commonMisconceptions: Isolators can go under any arrangement.
A unitary base can be set on springs.
An internally isolated roof ventilator needs external isolators.
assessmentOpportunities: Score line 'n of 7 first-attempt correct'; mastery is 6 of 7 on the first attempt.
